scripts.setup: npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:backend
scripts.setup:backend: composer --working-dir=backend install --no-interaction --no-progress && npm --prefix backend install && npm run backend:prepare
scripts.backend:prepare: npm run backend:env && npm run backend:migrate
scripts.backend:env: php -r "file_exists('backend/.env') || copy('backend/.env.example', 'backend/.env'); if (preg_match('/^DB_CONNECTION=sqlite$/m', file_get_contents('backend/.env'))) { file_exists('backend/database/database.sqlite') || touch('backend/database/database.sqlite'); } if (preg_match('/^APP_KEY=\s*$/m', file_get_contents('backend/.env'))) { passthru('php backend/artisan key:generate --force', $status); exit($status); }"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test
